summary: This directory manages the data structures, section definitions, and contextual requirements needed to generate package README files. It centralizes the configuration and type definitions that govern the content and structure of documentation produced by the system.
responsibilities: Define the required context for package README generation
Specify valid sections and their identifying markers
Maintain localized mappings for section titles and display labels
relationships: The ReadmeBuildContext provides the necessary data input to populate the document structure defined by the section identifiers.
Section identifiers act as keys to retrieve localized titles and link labels from the configuration dictionaries.
designDecisions: Use of strict type unions for section identifiers to ensure valid documentation structure
Centralization of localized display strings for consistent output
Separation of documentation context from generation logic
